parent_prompt_record_scope: Pre-dispatch prompt record supplied by the parent; not an exact agent-start timestamp.
first_clock_scope: Observed after initial complete-source and instruction reading.
first_script_timing_limit: The command-dispatch clock was measured. Blender script entry was not independently timestamped; the first command failed in authoring code before rendering.

first_actual_candidate_image.provenance: Original rendered PNG modification time retained by copy2, observed after completion; not an in-process first-pixel measurement.

timestamp_label_correction: The early construction-timing.json field named first_actual_rendered_candidate_utc records completion of the requested render bundle, not the first individual PNG. Its original value is retained.
first_useful_visual_observation: The first rendered candidate exposed the upper rear actuator assembly and differentiated the hand. It was retained but rejected as the final result because the shoulder return crossed the visible socket bore, surfaces were too sharply faceted, and distal tips were too pointed.
useful_change_timing_limit: The inspection clock was measured, but a separate exact decision timestamp was not captured. It is not retroactively inferred from the render publication time.
authoring_end_scope: Geometry, validation and authored report completed by this observed clock. Artifact materialization is separately timed as materialize-delivery in the command log.
guidance_accessed: Existing create, correction, refinement, local-edit, pose and export-check scripts
package_identity_authority: Parent verified all 17 packaged hashes against 1280b74d and instructed this path. The runner accepts that explicit source identity instead of inferring arbitrary skill-root identity.
subprocess_telemetry_scope: Every subprocess launched by run_construction.py has UTC start/end, monotonic duration, exit status and child CPU totals. Production CLI Blender subprocesses are included in those command durations and have retained production run metadata/logs; their inner monotonic launch time was not separately instrumented. Initial shell reads, image inspection and file housekeeping outside the runner remain visible in tool records but do not have a retrospectively invented full process timeline.
unavailable_cost_reason: Provider usage, billing, backend model snapshot and infrastructure pricing are not exposed.
concurrency: Two Blender CPU threads per invocation; separate garment author running concurrently.
benchmark_limit: This is informed continuation of a saved asset with prior critiques and source interpretation. It is not controlled no-skill/1.x/2.0 timing evidence.
